title: Hearty Russian Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring beef and vegetables wrapped in a paleo-friendly dough, perfect for a date-night dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, chopped carrot, and chopped celery, mixing well with your hands until just combined
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, baking powder, and salt
Add the egg to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the beef mixture, mixing until a cohesive dough forms
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each disk
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings, cooking for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface
